content.text: Jump to content From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia SkyKing is the name of two airlines: SkyKing Limited, a defunct airline formerly based on the Turks and Caicos Islands (merged into Air Turks and Caicos) Sky King, Inc., a charter airline based in the United States People[edit] Nickname for Richard Russell, American airport ground operator involved in the 2018 Horizon Air Q400 incident Other[edit] Emergency Action Message Topics referred to by the same term This disambiguation page lists articles associated with the title SkyKing.If an internal link incorrectly led you here, you may wish to change the link to point directly to the intended article.
